responsibility: Declares a small wrapper API for obtaining GCC-styled colored diagnostic substrings as `DynamicStrings`. The module exposes enable/disable control plus helpers for quote delimiters and named diagnostic color classes such as error, warning, note, filename, type, and range highlighting, so higher-level diagnostic formatting code can stay independent of GCC color escape details.
same_name_distinction: This `.def` file is the exported interface for M2ColorString: it declares the color-control and quoting/color helper procedures returning `DynamicStrings`, while `M2ColorString.mod` performs the actual wrapping of GCC `m2color` primitives and maintains the enable flag.
